metaDescription: La Carlota Soy 1 soybean is a grain soybean variety. About 89 days to harvest, 1.9 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: La Carlota Soy 1 soybean is a grain soybean variety, also sold or known as La Carlota Soy 1 (PSB Sy1) or PSB Sy1. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1990. It takes about 89 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.93 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

La Carlota Soy 1 soybean takes about 89 days from sowing to harvest. That is 4.4 days longer than the average of the 19 grain soybean varieties with a day count, 84.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.93 t/ha matches the average of its group, 1.92. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 89 to 95 days.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit soybean fields most often: [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 16.2 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed. The seed coat is light color. The seed holds 36.69 percent crude protein.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** About 2.85 t/ha wet season, 1.94 t/ha dry season.
**Fruit:** Light colored seed, about 15 to 16 g per 100 seeds.
**Where:** All regions, best in climate types 3 and 4 with early dry season planting, after corn or rice in Regions 2 and 4.
Registered in 1990 with the Philippine Seed Board.
Moderately resistant to bacterial pustule and soybean rust.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: long the national check soybean, accepted by Nestle for processing. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant La Carlota Soy 1 soybean
Grain soybean goes to feed and food processors, while vegetable soybean, or edamame, is picked green. Pick a variety rated against rust, the main soybean disease here.

items.q: Is La Carlota Soy 1 (PSB Sy1) the same as La Carlota Soy 1?
items.a: Yes. La Carlota Soy 1 (PSB Sy1) is another name for La Carlota Soy 1. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 89 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.93 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of La Carlota Soy 1?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
